meta.phi_local_def: Boltzmann-weighted (w=exp(-U_tot/kBT)) avg over the well [R,x_ridge] of the profile from the SELECTED model: :bvp uses the interpolated BVP surface conc phi_surf(x-R); :linear uses phi_inf - h0 exp(-lam(x-R)) R/x /(kappa(lam+1/R)). dphi/d2phi are central FD wrt phi_inf
meta.escape_setup: IC=delta at R; reflecting at R, absorbing at the FIXED dividing surface x_div (time R->x_div), on the phi-independent grid range(R,x_div,Ngrid)
meta.return_setup: IC=delta at the node x_div; absorbing at R, reflecting far end (time x_div->R), on the stored grid x_grid itself
meta.fisher_def: phi^2 (A_esc+A_ret), A=∫P(t|phi) (∂logP/∂phi)² dt (squared central 1st deriv in phi)
meta.x_div_def: single phi-independent dividing surface: the first stored node at or beyond max_phi x_ridge(phi), so it is at/past the barrier top for every phi.  Freezing it (instead of absorbing at each phi's own ridge) keeps the phi-derivative of logP from differencing a phi-dependent discretisation, which is what rippled the rate.
